samples.summary: Todo checklist is entirely unchecked despite the described work already being fully implemented in the working tree
samples.evidence: docs/tasks/active/20260822-sheets-merge-refusal-notice-todo.md lists every step under '## Plan' as an unchecked `- [ ]` item (e.g. 'Add a `RangeOpRefusal` reason type + `setOnRefusal` notification hook.'), but the model already defines `RangeOpRefusal` and `setOnRefusal` (packages/sheets/src/model/worksheet/sheet.ts:201-209, 2295-2337, 2392, 2461), the view already implements `refusalMessage`/`onNotice` (packages/sheets/src/view/worksheet.ts:98, 202, 417-418, 856; packages/sheets/src/view/spreadsheet.ts:410-414), the frontend already wires `onNotice` to a toast (packages/frontend/src/app/spreadsheet/sheet-view.tsx:1020), and tests for the three refusal reasons exist (packages/sheets/test/sheet/merge.test.ts, packages/sheets/test/sheet/autofill.test.ts). The todo file understates the actual state of the work, which could mislead a reader auditing task-file status.
